name: save_scene
title: save_scene
description: Writes the open scene to disk. Scene edits made by create_node_safe / attach_script_safe / safe_delete_node live in the editor's memory until this is called, so nothing is captured by a git checkpoint (and nothing survives a crash) until you save.

path.description: Save under a new path (Save As). Required the first time a scene is saved. Directories are created as needed.

errors.no_open_scene: No scene is open in the editor.
errors.scene_never_saved: The scene has no path yet; pass an explicit 'path'.
errors.invalid_path: Scene paths must start with res://.
